title: QFT Zoo methods list (data/methods.yaml)
description: The methods that a quantity's or operator's `method` field names by abbreviation. See CONTRIBUTING.md, "Methods".

abbr.description: What data rows write, e.g. 'MC-BC': no spaces or commas, at most 12 characters.

name.description: [markdown] Full name, shown on hover and on the Methods page.

parent.description: The abbr of the broader method this is a kind of (MC-BC: MC).

description.description: [markdown] One to three sentences: what the method is and what kind of error it gives.

links.description: Pages that explain the method (Wikipedia, a standard review).
